title: IMDb Consumer Site Modernization
bullets: Led the architectural transformation of IMDb's legacy Java monolith into a modern, responsive platform. Engineered shared design patterns enabling seamless migration of 100+ unique page types to a fully accessible, SEO-optimized stack (IMDbNext). Implemented comprehensive solutions for diverse product requirements across the platform.

title: IMDbNext
bullets: Architected and deployed one of the internet's largest Next.js implementations, serving 399k+ page views per minute. Established robust CI/CD pipeline supporting 60+ engineers with 4+ daily deployments. Optimized performance and scalability across the platform.

title: PLAID Pattern Library
bullets: Spearheaded development of IMDb's Pattern Library for Atomic Interface Design (PLAID). Led cross-functional collaboration with design and engineering teams to establish comprehensive design system standards and implementation guidelines.

title: GIG2.0
bullets: Architected and implemented a unified pattern library powering Groupon's consumer-facing platforms. Established core design system foundations across multiple business verticals to ensure consistent user experience.

title: Grainger Visual Update
bullets: Spearheaded the visual modernization initiative for Grainger's digital platform. Streamlined and standardized design patterns across the browse experience.

title: Qualified Pattern Lab
bullets: Created the Pattern Library and display patterns for the Qualified application.
